pupper.name: Pupper V3
pupper.note: Released Pupper V3 visualization mesh export (2024). Body and leg links are grouped assemblies, not separate printable shells. Not verified against the current Onshape revision. The grouped body visualization is separated into six disconnected source-mesh components for individual selection and color editing.
pupper.pose: Upstream URDF zero-joint pose; translated to ground, no dimensional scaling.

duck.name: Open Duck Mini v2
duck.note: Released Onshape-derived URDF visualization assembly from the v2 repository. Includes printed parts and hardware; visualization meshes are not a substitute for the separate upstream print files.
